title: Same %d-for-Swift-Int defect in inline String(format:) literals that the new strings-only ratchet cannot see
evidence: Sources/AiTaskbarApp/Views/CostFooterView.swift:283 and :302 use String(format: " (%d%%)", todayPct/weekPct), where todayPct/weekPct are Int(saturating:) (lines 259-260). Sources/AiTaskbarProviders/XAIWireTypes.swift:360 uses String(format: "%04d-%02d", y, m) with Int? year/month (lines 141-142). All values are bounded in practice (0-100, calendar year/month), so there is no visible truncation today. The CLAUDE.md rule added by this diff says 'every integer a call site formats is a Swift Int', and the gate only scans Localizable.strings.
fix: Switch these to %ld / %04ld-%02ld and consider extending check-source-ratchets.sh to String(format: "...%d...") literals in Sources/ (with a selftest plant)
